searchText: when i did my april furlough i kinda worked ahead, coming off the draft so i had two stories in the bag to write when i came back. may i didn’t have shit saved up. june, i’ve got 4 weeks or vacation after my furlough so i’m shutting it down for the summer. filed them an obit on joe schmidt this week in case he dies and i’ll do a story on kenny golladay getting a new contract i’m case he signs when i’m gone. yet that’s it freep dave birkett
